name: lifelong_benchmarks
description: A suite of benchmarks designed to evaluate continual (lifelong) learning performance across sequences of tasks, focusing on metrics like accuracy, forgetting, and transfer. It provides standardized task splits and scenarios to measure catastrophic forgetting and knowledge accumulation. Useful for comparing continual learning algorithms on realistic task streams.
reputation: Used within the continual learning research community as a standardized evaluation suite, but adoption is mostly among specialized ML researchers.
